item.description:

Copilot · Decide before 3 January 2027 whether to set BrowsingEnabled to Off or configure the new in-app browsing policies (downloads, authentication, network) to match your Edge baseline.

item.title: [New] Teams replaces the Copilot meeting policy with MeetingAI and TranscriptionWithMeetingAI; scripts using the old policy stop working, GA now January 2027
item.description:

Teams · Find every script, DSC or baseline that sets the Teams Copilot meeting policy and move it to MeetingAI and TranscriptionWithMeetingAI before January 2027; verify the mapped values afterwards.
